data.name: Order of the Asp
data.description: The cavalier gains a +%1 bonus on Knowledge (local) checks as long as the check involves her patrons or organization. She also reduces her armor check penalty when using Sleight of Hand by an amount equal to half her cavalier level (to a minimum of 0).|max(1,CavalierLVL/2)
